messages:
mike_infra: Heads up — ACME renewal in two weeks. Their Dedicated pool commit (currently 8x A100 reserved) looks misaligned with actual usage. Can we do a quick sizing and margin check?

sara_finance: Can we get last 6 weeks of committed vs actual usage + cloud invoice breakdown? need delta for the renewal deck.

jordan_sre: Link to recent dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/acme/dedicated-usage — but note the billing export vs internal metering sometimes drifts because of spot preempts and network egress.

lee_prodops: Quick numbers from internal meter (30d): sustained avg = 3.2 GPUs, p95 = 5.1 GPUs, peak = 7.8 GPUs. Region split: us-west-2 ~72%, eu-west-1 ~20%, others ~8%. Suggest commit of 5 GPUs with burst window to 8.

anya_sales: FYI ACME is asking for a modest price concession if we increase commit. They expect ~10% off list if we do a 12mo bump.

sara_finance: Rough cost calc (monthly): 
`list_commit_cost = 8 * $x_gpu_month` 
`proposed_commit_cost = 5 * $x_gpu_month * 0.9  # 10% concession` 
We need exact $x_gpu_month from cloud invoice + our internal unit economics.

mike_infra: Proposal draft: offer 5-GPU reserved commit (12mo) with 20% burst allowance to 8 GPUs, and an optional 60-day review. Include automatic fallback to on-demand if we hit sustained >6 GPUs for 14 days. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

billing-bot: Automated billing note: cloud invoice (acme-prod) last month = $78,412. Internal committed-metering = $75,980. Variance = +$2,432 (+3.2%).

jordan_sre: That +3.2% smells like preempted spot re-provisioning plus some cross-region egress. Recommend opening a cloud-billing ticket and running a detailed job-level billing join. I'll create the ticket. @mike_infra can you pull the job IDs for the top 10 consumers?

mike_infra: On it. I'll run a quick SQL against metering (last 90d) and post job_id + region + vm_type.

lee_prodops: Also check the autoscaler logs — a known bug last month double-provisioned for ~2 hours on a couple of rollouts, which could explain part of the delta. I can point to the PR.

anya_sales: I'll draft renewal language to reflect the 5-GPU commit, the burst policy, and a 60-day right-to-review. Want to align on pricing before I send the counter.

sara_finance: Once we have exact cloud unit price and the job-level billing join, I can produce the net margin impact and the recommended discount threshold. Target to have numbers by EOD tomorrow.

mike_infra: Thanks. Action items captured: 1) mike_infra — job-level export (90d) + capacity sim, 2) jordan_sre — open cloud-billing ticket, 3) lee_prodops — point to autoscaler double-provision PR, 4) sara_finance — margin calc after invoice join, 5) anya_sales — draft renewal language. Ping here if anything slips.

anya_sales: I'll also add a clause that allows a one-time commit re-sizing after 60 days if usage consistently <75% of committed throughput. That should help close the deal. :+1:

mike_infra: Great. I'll post the job export when ready.
